location: Blackrock Mountain, between the Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes
entrance: Deep in Blackrock Mountain: down the chains, through the Grinding Quarry to the Masonry. The portal is in the far corner.

4081.objective: Kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen.
4081.note: Starts at the Wanted Poster in Kargath. Report to Warlord Goretooth.

4082.objective: Kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers.
4082.note: Follows the first poster. Report to Warlord Goretooth.

4132.note: Three quests come first, among them a long escort.

4134.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave.
4134.note: Hurley Blackbreath drops the recipe in the Grim Guzzler. The Undercity has an optional breadcrumb.

7201.objective: Collect 10 Essence of the Elements from the golems and elementals in the dungeon.

3907.objective: Kill Lord Incendius and bring back the Tablet of Kurniya.
3907.note: Follows Disharmony of Flame, which sends you to Overmaster Pyron in the quarry outside.

3981.objective: Find Commander Gor'shak in the prison cells of the Detention Block.
3981.note: The Prison Cell Key from High Interrogator Gerstahn opens his cell. The chain continues with Thrall.

4003.objective: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard.
4003.note: The end of the Horde chain that starts with Commander Gor'shak.

4063.objective: Kill Golem Lord Argelmach and collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from his golems.
4063.note: Two quests of Lotwil Veriatus come first.

4263.note: Follows Overmaster Pyron, which sends you to the quarry outside the dungeon.

4286.objective: Collect 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs from the dwarves in the dungeon.

4126.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew.
4126.note: Hurley Blackbreath drops the recipe in the Grim Guzzler.

4341.objective: Find Kharan Mighthammer in the prison cells of the Detention Block.
4341.note: Two quests come first. The Prison Cell Key from Gerstahn opens his cell.

4362.objective: Kill Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and save Princess Moira Bronzebeard.
4362.note: The end of the Alliance chain with Kharan Mighthammer.

4241.objective: Find out what happened to Marshal Windsor. He sits in a cell of the Detention Block.
4241.note: Two quests come first, from Ragged John and Marshal Maxwell.

4322.objective: Escort Marshal Windsor while he gets his gear back and frees his friends.
4322.note: The end of a chain of six quests. A long escort through the Detention Block.

4136.objective: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot.
4136.note: Ribbly sits in the Grim Guzzler. Steamwheedle Port has an optional breadcrumb.

4123.objective: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint.
4123.note: The heart lies in a safe of the Black Vault, behind Warder Stilgiss.

7848.objective: Take a Core Fragment at the portal to Molten Core and bring it to Lothos Riftwaker.
7848.note: Cannot be shared. The portal is at the end of the Molten Bridge. Lothos stands in Blackrock Mountain.

3802.objective: Kill Fineous Darkvire, take Ironfel and place it on the statue at the Shrine of Thaurissan.
3802.note: The ghost of Franclorn Forgewright is only visible when you are dead. The reward is the Shadowforge Key.

4201.objective: Bring Mistress Nagmara 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial.

4024.objective: Kill Bael'Gar and use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on his remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
4024.note: The end of a chain of eleven quests from Cyrus Therepentous.
